scope: FP-PRE-ITER-CUT: break the FP scalar pre-round/iterative setup path fp_exec req_r.kind -> scalar_unit g_iter pp_pre.sig by splitting the pre-round first stage into unpack capture (ap_pre) and align/multiply (pp_pre); keep raw-bit/FPCR/FPSR/order semantics and only add fixed pipeline latency.

implementation.summary: In release FP_ITER=1 g_iter, added IT_ARITH pipeline stage and fp_arith_pre_t ap_pre/ap_pre_lo/ap_pre_hi registers. Stage 1 (IT_IDLE) captures unpacked/FZ-flushed operands and control; stage 2 (IT_ARITH) computes binary_pre_parts/fma_pre_parts/int_to_fp_pre and writes pp_pre*; stage 3 (IT_PREP) finishes with round_pack. This separates the slot/operand mux -> unpack -> align/multiply -> pp_pre combinational cone and removes req_r.kind as the direct source of pp_pre.sig. FCVT and pp_other paths plus FDIV/FSQRT iterative FSMs are unchanged.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; same unpack/round/pack helpers and finish_pre path
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; single outstanding fp_exec transaction and one held response
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot at acceptance, FPSR OR behavior preserved
semantics.kill_reset: ap_pre* registers cleared on reset/kill with other pipeline registers

runs.notes: Verilator lint-only on lcvex_core with release filelist

runs.command: conda run -n lcvex verilator --binary --timing --assert -j 1 --top-module lcvex_fp_exec_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv rtl/lcvex_neon_fp.sv tb/sv/lcvex_fp_exec_tb.sv && ./obj_dir_fp_exec_t034/Vlcvex_fp_exec_tb
runs.notes: Updated FADD.S=5 and NEON FADD.2S=9; includes single issue, held response, kill/reset, FDIV/FSQRT latency probes

not_run: Quartus full-FP synthesis/fitter/signoff STA (next FP-P5 rerun)
Cocotb P7-1/3/4/5 (not run in this task; SV + lcvex_fp_exec_tb cover the affected paths)
known_limits: No physical timing run in this task; actual Fmax/slack must be confirmed by FP-P5 rerun.
FCVT and pp_other/CMP/MINMAX/FRINT/FP-to-int paths were not further split in this round.
FP pre-round arithmetic latency increased by one cycle per slot; NEON by one per slot.
If STA still shows req_r.kind -> ap_pre or ap_pre -> pp_pre as top, next cut should be at fp_exec slot-input registers or a third pre-round stage.

integrator_review.notes: FP pre-round iterative cut merged and accepted
